description: Unit tests for the NetworkQualityStore component in the net/nqe module, testing caching behavior, signal strength handling, and cache size limits.

methods.name: TestCaching
methods.description: Tests adding, retrieving, and overwriting network quality entries in the cache, including handling of unknown connection types.

methods.name: TestCachingClosestSignalStrength
methods.description: Verifies that the cache returns the closest signal strength match and handles unknown signal strength appropriately.

methods.name: TestCachingUnknownSignalStrength
methods.description: Checks cache behavior when signal strength is marked as unknown (INT32_MIN).

methods.name: TestLRUCacheMaximumSize
methods.description: Ensures the cache size remains bounded and implements LRU eviction policy.
